result:
Direct calls, in order:

- `pathguard::PathGuard::new` — build write guard (INV-3/4)
- `walk::walk` — walk repo, get File nodes + ignore digest + hashes
- `lang::extract_and_resolve` — extract/resolve Symbol/Module nodes + edges
- `Graph::new` / `Graph::insert_node` / `Graph::insert_edge` — build graph in-memory
- `gitinfo::head_sha` — get commit sha
- `graph::PersistMeta` (struct construct) — bundle metadata
- `graph::persist` — write out (sort→redact→validate→caps→atomic write via guard)

Depends on modules: `error::Result`, `graph::Graph`, `gitinfo`, `graph`, `lang`, `pathguard`, `walk` (all `carto_core` internals). No external crates besides `serde` (derive on `IndexReport`).
